summary: The registrant filed a Form 8-K under Items 5.02 and 8.01 to announce the promotion of Bobby Lavan to President, in addition to his existing role as CFO, effective June 8, 2026. No consideration, premium, or transaction value is involved; the changes include an increase in annual base salary to $850,000 and a target LTIP award of $1.5 million. The board supported the move; no advisors were named. This is an internal executive succession that expands responsibilities without a departure. Watch for further management restructuring or retention strategy updates; no arbitrage angle exists.
